item.title: Postgres transactions are a distributed systems superpower
item.description:
📝 Shouldn’t workflow state live in one database and application data in another. Instead of checkpointing a step after its database transaction commits, a co-located workflow engine can write the step checkpoint and perform the database update in the same transaction. To do this, the workflow executes the step using a database transaction provided by the workflow engine.

item.title: Wireless LAN SD
item.description:
📝 The Wireless LAN SD standard is the first iSDIO standard that integrates normal SD memory cards with wireless LAN (Local Area Network) modules, which enables SD cards to execute complex communications tasks with simple host commands. Wireless LAN SD memory cards are now able to wirelessly transmit photographs and videos taken with most existing digital cameras and digital video cameras. A world created by Wireless LAN SD memory cards.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sdcard.org/developers/sd-standard-overview/sdio-isdio/wireless-lan-sd/
